subject: Cannot log in after password reset
description: User reset their password via the email link but the new password is rejected on the login page with 'invalid credentials'.
resolution: Cleared the cached session token and asked the user to reset the password again using an incognito window; confirmed login succeeded. Root cause was a stale session cookie overriding the new credentials.

subject: Password reset email never arrives
description: Customer requested a password reset three times but says the email never shows up, even in spam.
resolution: Found the account's email was on our provider's suppression list from a prior bounce. Removed it from the suppression list and manually resent the reset link, which the user received within a minute.

subject: Locked out after too many failed logins
description: User is locked out of their account after repeated failed login attempts and cannot self-service unlock.
resolution: Manually unlocked the account from the admin panel and walked the user through the correct password format. Advised enabling the 'show password' toggle to avoid future typos.

subject: SSO login redirects to blank page
description: When logging in via the company SSO provider, the user is redirected back to our app but sees a blank white page instead of the dashboard.
resolution: Identified an expired SSO certificate on our identity provider config. Rotated the certificate and the SSO redirect completed normally on retest.

subject: Invoice shows duplicate charge
description: Customer was billed twice for the same monthly subscription in one billing cycle.
resolution: Confirmed a duplicate charge caused by a retried webhook from the payment processor. Refunded the duplicate charge and added an idempotency key to the billing webhook handler.

subject: Invoice total doesn't match plan price
description: The invoice PDF shows a total that is $10 higher than the advertised plan price with no visible line item explaining the difference.
resolution: Traced the discrepancy to a prorated upgrade charge from mid-cycle that wasn't labeled clearly. Reissued the invoice with an explicit 'prorated upgrade' line item and explained the charge to the customer.

subject: Credit card declined but subscription still active
description: User's card was declined during renewal, but they were never notified and the subscription silently downgraded to free tier.
resolution: Enabled failed-payment email notifications and manually restored the user's paid tier after they updated their card. Backfilled the missing days of paid access as a goodwill credit.

subject: Refund not reflected in account balance
description: Customer received a refund confirmation email but their account balance in the billing dashboard still shows the old amount.
resolution: Found the billing dashboard was reading from a cached balance snapshot refreshed only once per day. Forced a manual cache refresh and shortened the cache TTL to 15 minutes.

subject: API returns 429 errors during normal usage
description: Integration partner reports frequent 429 Too Many Requests errors even though their traffic is well under the documented rate limit.
resolution: Discovered the rate limiter was counting requests per API key globally instead of per endpoint, exhausting the shared budget quickly. Fixed the limiter to key on (api_key, endpoint) and rate limits behaved as documented.

subject: Rate limit headers missing from API responses
description: Developer says our API responses don't include X-RateLimit-Remaining headers, making it hard to back off proactively.
resolution: Added the missing X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers to every API response and published the change in the API changelog.

subject: Bulk import endpoint times out under load
description: Calling the /bulk-import API endpoint with more than 500 records consistently times out after 30 seconds.
resolution: Added pagination support so clients can submit records in batches of 100, and increased the endpoint timeout to 60 seconds for the interim. Documented the new batching requirement.

subject: API key stopped working with no warning
description: A previously working API key suddenly returns 401 Unauthorized with no prior notice of expiration.
resolution: Found API keys were silently expiring after 90 days with no reminder. Issued the customer a new key immediately and added an email reminder sent 7 days before key expiration.

subject: CSV export is missing recent records
description: Customer exported their data to CSV but the file is missing records created in the last 24 hours.
resolution: Traced the issue to the export job reading from a read replica with replication lag. Switched the export job to read from the primary database for exports smaller than 10,000 rows.

subject: Data export file is corrupted
description: The exported ZIP file customers download fails to open, showing a 'corrupted archive' error in most unzip tools.
resolution: Found the export was being truncated when generation exceeded a 5-minute Lambda timeout. Increased the function timeout and added a checksum step to verify the archive before making it downloadable.

subject: Import fails silently with no error message
description: Uploading a CSV of contacts for import appears to succeed but none of the records show up afterward, with no error shown.
resolution: Identified that rows with an unescaped comma in a free-text field were silently dropped during parsing. Switched the importer to a strict CSV parser that surfaces malformed rows to the user instead of dropping them.

subject: Export button does nothing on Safari
description: Clicking 'Export Data' produces no visible response in Safari, though it works fine in Chrome.
resolution: Found a Safari-specific issue where the download was blocked because the export used a data URI over the browser's size limit. Switched to a blob-based download link, which works across all major browsers.

subject: Not receiving order confirmation emails
description: Customer placed an order and never received the confirmation email, though the order shows as completed in our system.
resolution: Determined the transactional email provider had a delayed queue during a traffic spike, delaying delivery by over an hour. Resent the confirmation immediately and added a delivery-time alert for the provider's queue depth.

subject: Notification emails going to spam folder
description: Multiple customers report that our weekly digest emails are landing in their spam folder instead of the inbox.
resolution: Found our sending domain was missing a DMARC record, hurting sender reputation. Published a proper SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configuration, and inbox placement improved within a week.

subject: Duplicate notification emails sent
description: User received the same 'password changed' notification email five times within a minute.
resolution: Found a retry loop in the notification worker that resent on any non-200 response, including from a flaky logging endpoint unrelated to delivery. Fixed the retry logic to only retry on actual send failures.

subject: Unsubscribe link in emails doesn't work
description: Clicking 'unsubscribe' in marketing emails leads to an error page and the user keeps receiving emails afterward.
resolution: Found the unsubscribe token had a bug in URL encoding for addresses containing a '+' character. Fixed the encoding and manually unsubscribed the affected users who had reported the issue.
